tasks.label: py run dev
tasks.command: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $python=(Join-Path $root '.venv\Scripts\python.exe'); if (-not (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 5500 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Start-Process -FilePath $python -ArgumentList '-m','http.server','5500','--bind','127.0.0.1' -WorkingDirectory $root }; Start-Process 'http://localhost:5500/index.html'; & $python -m uvicorn src.interface.main:app --reload --port 8000
